dsh.ext.description: Embed the local DeepSeek Harness (DSH) web UI into the VS Code auxiliary sidebar.
dsh.cfg.title: DeepSeek Harness(dsh) for VS Code
dsh.cfg.port: Port to probe / start the DSH web server.
dsh.cfg.host: Bind address. Keep 127.0.0.1 — the webview iframe only allows 127.0.0.1/localhost.
dsh.cfg.autoStart: Start the locally installed official DSH for this VS Code window, using the selected shared or isolated DSH home and web profile. If no local package is found, an already running configured endpoint may be reused (false = reuse only).
dsh.cfg.profile: DSH profile directory name under the selected DSH home. Each VS Code window can use a different profile; the value must match ^[A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,64}$.
dsh.cfg.home.mode: DSH configuration mode. shared (default) uses the official DSH_HOME and exposes existing modules, skills, providers, credentials, and sessions. isolated uses an extension-private home that initially contains only the official profile.
dsh.cfg.home.path: Optional absolute DSH home override for shared mode. Empty follows official precedence: inherited DSH_HOME, then ~/.dsh. Machine-scoped so workspace settings cannot redirect executable DSH configuration.
dsh.cfg.closePolicy: When to stop the extension-owned DSH server. onVscodeExit (default): stop only when VS Code exits. onViewClose: also stop when the sidebar view is closed. never: never stop automatically — use the Stop DSH Server command. A reused (non-owned) instance is never stopped.
dsh.cfg.local.packageRoot: Optional absolute path to the official @deepseek-ai/dsh package root. Empty = detect the global npm installation automatically.
dsh.cfg.local.nodePath: Optional absolute path to the Node.js executable used to launch the official DSH package. Empty = detect Node.js automatically.
dsh.cfg.runtime.manifestUrl: Optional HTTPS runtime release manifest (schemaVersion 1, artifacts with embedded manifests). Empty = use the locally installed official npm DSH; non-empty = opt into verified managed-runtime provisioning.
dsh.cfg.runtime.version: Optional managed-runtime version pin; used only when dsh.runtime.manifestUrl is configured.
dsh.cfg.features.clipboard-bridge: Embedded copy/paste bridge between the DSH iframe and the VS Code clipboard.
dsh.cfg.features.thread-attachment: Add the active file/selection/problems to the DSH conversation (Add to Thread commands and thread module).
dsh.cfg.features.editor-links: Open DSH Read… and draft attachment links in this VS Code window (text document bridge).
dsh.cfg.features.statusbar-basic: Basic DSH status indicator in the status bar.
dsh.cfg.features.theme-follow: Follow the VS Code active color theme in the embedded DSH iframe (dark/light).
dsh.cfg.keybindings.ctrlL: Enable the Ctrl+L (Cmd+L on macOS) keybinding that adds the active selection to the DSH conversation. Off by default.
dsh.cfg.multiInstance.entry: Show the new-instance entry in the DSH sidebar title bar. Off by default.
dsh.view.title: DeepSeek Harness (DSH)
dsh.view.name: DeepSeek Harness (DSH)
dsh.cap.untrusted: Launches a local process and touches workspace files.
dsh.cap.virtual: Requires the dsh CLI and a real file system.
dsh.cmd.addActiveFile: Add Active File to DSH Context
dsh.cmd.addActiveSelection: Add Active Selection to DSH Context
